description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific Stripe Climate product. Use when you need to get information about a particular carbon removal product including pricing and supplier details.

inputSchema.description: Request model for retrieving a climate product.

product.description: The unique identifier of the Climate product to retrieve (e.g., 'climsku_planetary_2027').
product.title: Product

inputSchema.title: GetClimateProductsProductRequest

name: get_climate_products_product

CurrencyPrice.description: Pricing information for a specific currency.

amount_fees.description: The fees amount in the smallest currency unit (e.g., cents for USD).
amount_fees.title: Amount Fees

amount_subtotal.description: The subtotal amount in the smallest currency unit (e.g., cents for USD).
amount_subtotal.title: Amount Subtotal

amount_total.description: The total amount in the smallest currency unit (e.g., cents for USD).
amount_total.title: Amount Total

CurrencyPrice.title: CurrencyPrice

GetClimateProductsProductResponse.description: Response from retrieving a Stripe Climate product.

created.description: Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
created.title: Created

delivery_year.description: The expected year when carbon removal will be delivered.
delivery_year.title: Delivery Year

id.description: Unique identifier for the climate product.
id.title: Id

livemode.description: Has the value true if the object exists in live mode or the value false if the object exists in test mode.
livemode.title: Livemode

metric_tons_available.description: The quantity of carbon removal available in metric tons.
metric_tons_available.title: Metric Tons Available

name.description: The name of the climate product.
name.title: Name

object.description: String representing the object's type. Value is 'climate.product'.
object.title: Object

suppliers.description: List of supplier objects providing this carbon removal product.
suppliers.title: Suppliers

GetClimateProductsProductResponse.title: GetClimateProductsProductResponse

info_url.description: URL with more information about the supplier.
info_url.title: Info Url

livemode.description: Has the value true if the object exists in live mode or the value false if the object exists in test mode.
livemode.title: Livemode

locations.description: The locations where the supplier operates.
locations.title: Locations

object.description: String representing the object's type. Always 'climate.supplier'.
object.title: Object
